skills.does: Count the syllables — the beats — in a word or a text.
Strip accents and convert a text to plain ASCII.
examples: strip the accents from Münster Straße

skills.does: Break a passage at its full stops into separate sentences.
Break a sentence at its spaces into separate words.
Remove the leading and trailing spaces from every line of a text, leaving the lines themselves in place.
examples: trim the spaces off each line
trim lines and drop the empty ones

skills.does: Cut text off at a maximum length and end it with an ellipsis.
examples: truncate a string already short enough

skills.does: Which words repeat most in a text — each distinct word ranked by how often it recurs.
examples: what words come up most in this text
most common words including the small ones
word counts for a repeated phrase

skills.does: Hard-wrap text to a maximum line width, breaking lines at a set number of characters.
Rewrite a phone number in E.164, international or national form.
examples: normalise this us number to e164
write this indian number in international form

skills.does: Estimate how much entropy a password has and flag predictable patterns.
examples: how strong is the password password

skills.does: Check whether a date actually exists on the calendar.
Say whether an email address is written correctly.
Test a hex colour code and expand #abc shorthand.
Test an IBAN bank number against its own checksum.
Test an IP address and say whether it is IPv4, IPv6 or neither.
Check an ISBN-10 or ISBN-13 book number against its check digit.
Check whether some JSON parses, and say exactly where the error is if it does not.
examples: why will this json not parse

skills.does: Check whether a JSON document matches a JSON Schema.
examples: does this json match the schema
validate this data against my schema
check the age is in range

skills.does: Check a card number against the Luhn checksum.
examples: validate a number with a typo

skills.does: Say whether a phone number has the right shape for its country.
examples: is this a valid phone number

skills.does: Say whether a web address is well formed, and split out its host and path.
examples: break this url into its parts

skills.does: Test a UUID and say which version it is.
Check a title against title-case rules and show which words were wrong.
examples: title case a tale of two cities

skills.does: Check a draft against a word count target and say how far off it is.
examples: is my 450 word draft close to 500 words
how far off 1000 words am I
am I over the 250 word limit

skills.does: Pull the heading structure out of a markdown document as a plain outline.
examples: get the headings out of this markdown
find the headings, ignoring code fences

skills.does: Spot the sentences that run on past a word limit.
examples: find the long sentences in this
are any of my sentences too long
check this paragraph for long sentences

skills.does: Spot a word used again too soon after itself.
examples: find repeated words in this text

skills.does: Assemble a reference in APA, MLA or Chicago style from details you provide.
examples: format this as an APA reference
make an MLA citation for this book

skills.does: Build a linked table of contents to sit at the top of a document.
examples: make a table of contents for this markdown
table of contents down to level two only

skills.does: Convert Markdown into HTML.
Turn your own indented notes into markdown headings and bullets.
examples: convert my indented notes to markdown
outline to markdown with two heading levels

skills.does: Break a document into paragraphs and report the word and sentence count of each.
examples: break this document into paragraph stats
paragraph breakdown of a single block

skills.does: Make one English word into many — its plural.
examples: what is the plural of child

skills.does: Cut a plural English word back to one of the thing.
examples: what is the singular of children

skills.does: Find words that are not in the dictionary and suggest corrections.
